attchmntText: Manaksia Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Manaksia Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in the Business Standard and Ekdin newspapers on 14th November 2026. The consolidated net profit after tax for the quarter was 1,118.05 lakh rupees, compared to 1,049.31 lakh rupees in the same period of 2025. The standalone net profit after tax was 81.98 lakh rupees, compared to 284.31 lakh rupees in the prior year period. Earnings per share for the quarter was 1.68 rupees. The Board of Directors approved the demerger of Manaksia Ferrous Engineering Limited under Section 230 to 232 of the Companies Act 2013. This scheme is subject to approval by the National Company Law Tribunal and has been filed with the NCLT. Regal Resources Limited also published its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The standalone net profit after tax was 81.98 lakh rupees for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Manaksia Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manaksia Limited disclosed the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 5,395.46 lacs for the quarter and 9,276.70 lacs for the half year. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at 18,809.66 lacs for the quarter and 41,085.49 lacs for the half year. Standalone net profit was 120.84 lacs for the quarter and 859.04 lacs for the half year. Consolidated net profit was 1,869.48 lacs for the quarter and 5,761.20 lacs for the half year. The results include a Limited Review Report from S K Agrawal and Co Chartered Accountants LLP.
